title: Secura Electric Coffee Grinder and Spice Grinder with 2 Stainless Steel Blades Removable Bowls
description:
About this item
Multi-Use - Ideal for grinding coffee, spices, herbs, nuts, and even grains—this versatile grinder meets all your kitchen needs
Removable Grinding Bowls – Comes with two separate bowls for coffee and spices, ensuring easy cleanup and preventing flavor mixing
Press Operation - Simple, user-friendly press control makes it easy to grind with precision, whether you prefer a coarse or fine grind
Overheat Protection – Automatically shuts off if the motor gets too hot, preventing damage and extending the grinder's lifespan
Notice - Avoid grinding extremely hard foods like cinnamon, cloves, or coconut, as they may doing damage to the motor, the lid, or cause other issues
› See more product details
reviews_5s:
I’ve been using the Secura electric grinder for a few weeks, and I like it! It’s strong enough to grind coffee beans in just a few seconds. It also comes with an extra bowl for spices, which is a nice bonus. I’ve used it for things like peppercorns and flaxseeds, and it works great every time for a variety of things.

The stainless steel bowls are easy to remove and clean, making things simple—no mess or fuss. It’s not too loud, and it doesn’t take up much space on my counter.I bought the one with the 2 Stainless Steel Blades Removable Bowls 8 months ago. I use one to grind my coffee and the other (the one that can hold thick liquids) to the mix my whey protein isolate with my nut creamer before put it in my hot coffee. I also use it the make a nut butter, etc. It is so good I am think to buy a second one just to have it an extra one.I love this grinder! I just bought my third one, this one going to our vacation home in Florida! It grinds the perfect amount of grounds for a 12-cup pot of coffee. We like it strong, so I fill the grinder cup with beans just over the fill line. It is much quieter than our other grinder and ensures a fresh ground coffee flavor!

This is also great for fancy cooks who like to grind their own spices!I just received it today. The quality is nice. It came in beautiful packaging. What I like about it. reviews_1s:
I ordered this grinder as an extra. First off, the quality of the bowl is nice. No sharp edges like the KitchenAid. Bowl fits securely into the base, unlike the KitchenAid. The bowl for grinding spices is not the same as the previous model I purchased 19 Aug 2022. The redesigned model does not have the black pad below the blade. On the previous bowl, one blade tip faced up and the other down. On the newer one, both tips face up. I contacted Secura and was eventually sent a replacement bowl. It was the exact, redesigned, same thing. I was contacted by Secura via email "Thank you for providing the pictures. We believe it is exactly the correct replacement grinder bowl. The grinder bowl was slightly redesigned as some customers reported that they would like the black plastic pad removed. The new design improves grinding efficiency and it is easier to clean the bowl. Please let us know if we can be of any further assistance. Warm regards, Secura Customer Service TeamSpice G". Slightly? How many is some? The bowl was not hard to clean in the first place; soak and just use a toothbrush. It is not more efficient. It took me three times as long or longer to grind as before and still had small clumps. Did Secura even test their own redesign? Obviously not. The grinder was highly rated for what it was designed to do, grind spices, and the original bowl does an amazing job of it. It no longer does that. I received the copycat Shardor today hoping to get the bowl with the black pad. I did not receive the bowl with the black pad. Shardor replaced theirs with the same useless one as Secura. Shardor is going back to Amazon. Secura/Shardor, Please bring back the original grinder bowl like the one I purchased in Aug 2022, or at least make it an available option such as your Replacement Parts Stainless Steel Removable Bowl Set. I do not recommend this "redesigned" grinder bowl. Thank youThis is the worst coffee grinder I’ve ever gotten. Absolutely worthless. The unevenness of the grind is absolutely off the charts. It fared slightly less bad at chopping spices, but still not great. The coffee grinding option is so bad that it’s worthless. I can’t fathom why there’s good reviews, because it’s truly terrible. Maybe they have abysmal quality control and mine is one of the very bad ones, but it’s hard to imagine this machine doing good. The only positive about it is that it’s stainless steel inside, but that’s not worth much if it can’t grind anything properly.
